les: Twee maniere om afstand op 'n kaart te wys

items.bewering: 'n Kaart kan 'n hele stad of land op een bladsy wys.
items.bron: KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 1, bl. 29: 'verskillende skale vir verskillende kaarte - van wêreldkaarte tot straatkaarte'; Geography Realm, 'A Guide to Understanding Map Scale' (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): scale shows how much a map has been reduced from reality.

items.bewering: Die kaart se skaal sê vir jou hoeveel kleiner die plek op die kaart gemaak is.
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): map scale is the ratio between distance on the map and distance on the ground, i.e. how much the map is reduced from reality.

items.bewering: Die kaartmaker druk die skaal in 'n hoek of naby 'n rand.
items.bron: NSW Department of Education, 'BOLTSS and scale' (https://education.nsw.gov.au/teaching-and-learning/curriculum/hsie/hsie-curriculum-resources-k-12/hsie-7-10-curriculum-resources/boltss-and-scale): title, scale and source go along the bottom of the map; Texas A&M International University lecture 3 'Map scales' (https://www.tamiu.edu/cees/courses/fall2018/geol4460_labs/lecture3.pdf): graphic scale normally near the bottom; Ordnance Survey Mapzone 'Measuring Distance' shows the scale bar in the bottom margin. Web maps place it in a bottom corner. 'In a corner or near an edge' is a fair general description; it is not an absolute rule but is not stated as one.

items.bewering: In hierdie werk kry jy net twee soorte skale: 'n woordskaal en 'n lynskaal.
items.bron: KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 1, bl. 29 (PDF-bl. 34): bullets 'Lynskaal' and 'Woordskaal', footnote '* Gebruik slegs woord- en lynskale.' The claim is limited to 'this work', so it correctly does not deny that a third kind (the ratio or representative fraction, e.g. 1:50 000) exists; Geography Realm lists all three.

items.bewering: Die woordskaal skryf die skaal in gewone woorde neer. So 'n sin kan lui: een sentimeter op die kaart is vyftig kilometer op die aarde.
items.blok: Die woordskaal sê dit in woorde
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): a verbal scale is text-based, e.g. '1 inch = 100 feet', meaning one map unit stands for that ground distance. The example sentence has the standard form (map unit first, ground distance second).

items.bewering: Die eerste afstand lê op die papier en die tweede op die aarde.
items.blok: Die woordskaal sê dit in woorde
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): in a verbal scale the first quantity is the map distance and the second the ground distance.

items.bewering: 'n Kaart met 'n woordskaal het sy eie getalle in daardie sin.
items.blok: Die woordskaal sê dit in woorde
items.bron: KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 1, bl. 29: 'verskillende skale vir verskillende kaarte'. Each map's verbal scale states that map's own ratio.

items.bewering: Die lynskaal is 'n kort reguit lyntjie op die kaart. Die lyntjie is in gelyke stukke verdeel, soos die merke op 'n lineaal.
items.blok: Die lynskaal wys dit met 'n lyntjie
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): graphic (bar) scales use bars or tick marks to show units; search excerpts of Esri ArcGIS Blog 'Choosing the best way to indicate map scale': each segment represents a set ground distance. Analogy mapping checked: like a ruler, the line is divided into equal, numbered steps counted from zero, and you read a length off it. The one place the comparison could mislead (a ruler's numbers are paper centimetres) is closed by the next sentence, which says the numbers are distances on the earth.

items.bewering: Die getalle by die merke sê hoe ver dit op die aarde van die nul af is. In ons voorbeeld is dit nul, vyftig en honderd kilometer.
items.blok: Die lynskaal wys dit met 'n lyntjie
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/) and Ordnance Survey Mapzone 'Measuring Distance' (https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/mapzone/assets/doc/map-skills/Measuring-Distance-en.pdf): the scale bar is labelled in ground units (kilometres) from zero. The 0-50-100 km example is internally consistent (it also matches the word-scale example if the bar is 2 cm long, though the lesson does not claim they are one map).

items.bewering: Jy lê die rand van 'n strokie papier tussen twee plekke op die kaart en merk albei plekke daarop. Dan lê jy die een merk by die nul van die lynskaal. By die ander merk lees jy af hoeveel kilometer dit is.
items.blok: Die lynskaal wys dit met 'n lyntjie
items.bron: Ordnance Survey Mapzone 'Measuring Distance', 'On the paper's edge' (https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk/mapzone/assets/doc/map-skills/Measuring-Distance-en.pdf), read in full: mark the route on a paper's straight edge, place the sheet against the scale bar, and the last mark gives the real distance. The lesson's two-mark straight-line version is the same method, and matches the CAPS bullet 'Meet reguitlyn-afstande tussen stede'.

items.bewering: Solank die kaart so groot is as wat die kaartmaker dit gemaak het, sê 'n woordskaal en 'n lynskaal dieselfde ding.
items.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
items.bron: Esri ArcGIS Blog 'Choosing the best way to indicate map scale' (https://www.esri.com/arcgis-blog/products/product/mapping/choosing-the-best-way-to-indicate-map-scale, via search excerpt; the page itself returned 403): verbal scale and scale bar both indicate the map's scale, and diverge only once the map is enlarged or reduced. The condition in the sentence is exactly the right one.

items.bewering: Die woordskaal is maklik om te lees, en die lynskaal is maklik om mee te meet.
items.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): a verbal scale is plain text; Ordnance Survey Mapzone 'Measuring Distance': distances are read directly by laying a marked edge against the scale bar, with no calculation. A comparative judgement rather than a hard fact, and supported. (One source notes a bar gives less precise readings than calculation; 'easy to measure with' does not claim precision.)

items.bewering: Albei kan op een kaart staan, en baie kaarte dra net een van die twee.
items.blok: Twee maniere om dieselfde ding te sê
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): maps can carry more than one scale indicator (USGS topographic maps typically show a bar scale and a representative fraction together); Kagi feedback thread (https://kagifeedback.org/d/727-add-scale-indicator-to-maps) and the Ordnance Survey example: Google Maps, OpenStreetMap and OS sheets show a scale bar without a verbal scale. The claim says 'many', not 'most', and holds.

items.bewering: Dieselfde kaart kan klein in 'n boek staan en groot teen 'n muur hang. Die lyntjie van die lynskaal krimp of groei saam met die kaart. Die stukke word korter of langer maar wys steeds dieselfde afstand.
items.bron: Esri ArcGIS Blog 'Choosing the best way to indicate map scale' (search excerpt): 'If the map is enlarged or reduced using some method of photocopying or screen display, the scale bar changes size in direct proportion to the physical size of the map'; Vedantu and the Open WA textbook (search excerpts) say the same.

items.bewering: 'n Woordskaal se sin bly dieselfde en pas dan nie meer by die kaart nie.
items.bron: Esri ArcGIS Blog (search excerpt): 'verbal scales and representative fraction ... will become incorrect when the map changes size'; Open WA textbook (search excerpt): verbal and fractional scales are vulnerable to resizing.

items.bewering: Kaarte dra 'n lynskaal juis omdat hy op elke grootte reg bly.
items.bron: Esri ArcGIS Blog (search excerpt) and Open WA textbook (search excerpt): a graphic scale stays valid at any size, which is the reason given for preferring it when a map may be reproduced or shown on screen. It is a main reason, not the only one (ease of measuring is another, and the lesson gives that in the block before), and the sentence does not say every map carries one, so it does not clash with 'baie kaarte dra net een van die twee'.

items.bewering: woordskaal: 'n Kaart se skaal wat as 'n sin in woorde gegee word.
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/): a verbal scale is a text statement of the scale; KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 1, bl. 29 uses the term 'Woordskaal'.

items.bewering: lynskaal: 'n Kaart se skaal as 'n verdeelde lyntjie; elke gelyke stuk staan vir dieselfde afstand op die aarde.
items.bron: Geography Realm (https://www.geographyrealm.com/map-scale/) and Esri search excerpt: a bar scale is a line marked off in ground units, each segment representing a set ground distance; KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 1, bl. 29 uses the term 'Lynskaal'. The definition holds on its own, without the lesson around it.

opsomming: Every claim in the lesson checks out against the CAPS page and cartography sources, the ruler comparison holds because the next sentence says the numbers are distances on the earth, and nothing needs fixing; the thinnest point is where on a map the scale is printed, which rests on school-level sources (NSW education, a university lecture) and is worded loosely enough to be safe.
